_note: 學習路徑內容建置第5批 #6／6：would 的用法（eng.t_adv.modal.would，學測級／高階）。(1) 過去重複的習慣（like used to，但狀態動詞用 used to 不用 would）；(2) 禮貌的請求與提議（Would you…? Would you like…?，would like＝想要）；(3) 意願／假設結果（I would help if…）。皆標準英語，經對抗式英語母語複核（每選項代入 stem 驗唯一正解、play-through 朗讀）。音檔 edge-tts 童聲（prefix wld_）。

units.can_do: 我能用 would 表達過去重複的習慣（When I was young, we would…，但狀態要用 used to）、禮貌的請求與提議（Would you…? / Would you like…?，would like＝想要），以及意願或假設的結果（I would help you if…）。
units.subject: eng

claims.text: 'would' can describe a repeated action or habit in the past, similar to 'used to': When I was a child, my grandfather would tell me stories every night.
claims.verification_ref: would＝過去重複的習慣（like used to）；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: 'would' makes requests and offers more polite: Would you open the window, please? Would you like some tea?
claims.verification_ref: would 用於禮貌請求與提議；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: 'would' expresses willingness or an imagined result, often with an 'if' idea: I would help you if I had more time. He said he would call later.
claims.verification_ref: would 表意願/假設結果；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: For a past state (not a repeated action) we use 'used to', not 'would': I used to live in Tainan. (not 'I would live in Tainan' for a state)
claims.verification_ref: 過去狀態用 used to 不用 would；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: 'would like' is a polite way to say 'want', and is followed by a noun or 'to + verb': I would like a glass of water. I would like to go home.
claims.verification_ref: would like＝禮貌地想要（接名詞或 to+原形）；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

teach.body: The first common use of 'would' is to talk about a repeated action or habit in the past, with a meaning close to 'used to'. It often goes with a past time frame like 'When I was young' or 'every day'.
teach.zh_hint: would 的第一個常見用法：講「過去一再重複的習慣」，意思接近 used to。常搭配 When I was young／every day 這類時間背景。

teach.body: When I was young, we would visit my grandparents every summer.
teach.zh_hint: 我小時候，我們每年夏天都會去看祖父母。would＝過去習慣。

teach.body: The second use makes a request or an offer more polite: Would you...? and Would you like...? 'Would like' is a polite way to say 'want', and it is followed by a noun or 'to + base verb'.
teach.zh_hint: 第二個用法：讓請求或提議更禮貌。Would you…?（可以請你…嗎）、Would you like…?（你想要…嗎）。would like 就是比較客氣的 want（想要），後面接名詞或 to ＋ 原形。

teach.body: Would you pass me the salt, please? I would like a cup of coffee.
teach.zh_hint: 可以請你把鹽遞給我嗎？我想要一杯咖啡。禮貌請求／would like＝想要。

teach.body: The third use expresses willingness or an imagined result, often with an 'if' idea. Note: for a past state (like live, have, or be), use 'used to', not 'would'.
teach.zh_hint: 第三個用法：表達意願或「假設情況下會怎樣」的結果（常和 if 一起）。注意：如果講的是過去的「狀態」（像 live、have、be），要用 used to，不用 would。

teach.body: I would help you if I had more time. I used to live in Tainan.
teach.zh_hint: 如果我有多一點時間，我會幫你。我以前住在台南。意願／假設用 would；過去狀態用 used to。

practice.stem: 填入正確的詞：When I was little, my mom ____ read me a story every night.（我小時候，媽媽每天晚上都會唸故事給我聽。過去習慣）

distractor_rationales.will: will 是未來式；這裡 When I was little 是過去，講過去習慣要用 would。
distractor_rationales.would be: 這裡要用 would ＋ 原形 read；would be 後面不能接原形動詞（be 後面接形容詞／名詞／-ing，如 would be happy），所以不合。
distractor_rationales.is going to: is going to 講未來的打算；過去習慣要用 would。

practice.feedback: 過去一再重複的習慣用 would ＋ 原形：my mom would read me a story。

practice.stem: 填入正確的詞：____ you like something to drink?（你想要喝點什麼嗎？禮貌提議）

distractor_rationales.Do: Do you like…? 是問「你平常喜不喜歡」，不是當下的提議；禮貌提議用 Would you like…?。
distractor_rationales.Are: Are you like…? 無法表達『你想要…嗎』的禮貌提議；提議固定用 Would you like…?。
distractor_rationales.Will: Will you like 不是慣用的提議說法；固定用 Would you like…?。

practice.feedback: 禮貌提議的固定說法是 Would you like…?：Would you like something to drink?。

practice.stem: 填入正確的詞：I ____ live in Kaohsiung, but now I live in Taipei.（我以前住在高雄，但現在住在台北。過去的狀態）

distractor_rationales.would: would 用於過去「重複的動作」；live 是「狀態」，過去狀態要用 used to。
distractor_rationales.would be: would be 後面不接原形 live；而且過去狀態用 used to。
distractor_rationales.am used to: am used to ＋ -ing 是「習慣於」，意思不同；這裡是「以前住」，用 used to live。

practice.feedback: 過去的狀態（住）用 used to，不用 would：I used to live in Kaohsiung。

practice.stem: 填入正確的詞：I ____ help you if I weren't so busy.（如果我沒那麼忙，我就會幫你。假設）

distractor_rationales.will: if 子句用了 weren't（與現實相反的假設），主句要用 would，不是 will。
distractor_rationales.would to: would 後面直接接原形 help，沒有 to：would help。
distractor_rationales.am going to: am going to 講真實的未來打算；這是假設情況，要用 would。

practice.feedback: 假設情況下的結果用 would ＋ 原形：I would help you if I weren't so busy。

practice.stem: 填入正確的詞：Excuse me, I ____ a table for two, please.（不好意思，我想要一張兩人桌，謝謝。）

distractor_rationales.would like to: to 後面要接原形動詞，但這裡接的是名詞 a table；接名詞要用 would like（不加 to）。
distractor_rationales.will like: will like 是「將會喜歡」，不是禮貌地點餐；要用 would like。
distractor_rationales.like: I like a table 是「我（平常）喜歡桌子」，不是禮貌地想要；要用 would like。

practice.feedback: would like＝禮貌地想要，後接名詞不加 to：I would like a table for two。

practice.stem: 聽音檔，把整句寫下來（聽寫）。
practice.answer: When we were young, my sister and I would walk to school together every morning.
practice.feedback: 對照答案自評：would walk（過去習慣）有沒有用對，together／every morning 有沒有漏，逗號和句點有沒有漏。

units.selfeval_note: 翻看答案自己判斷（不自動判讀）；選完進入 SRS 間隔複習。

shadowing.note: 跟著讀＋語調模仿：播音檔→跟著讀→自評（不自動判發音）。Would you…? 的提議句句尾可略上揚，過去習慣的直述句句尾下收。

lines.text: Would you like some more tea?
lines.intonation: 提議句、句尾略上揚、tea 稍強調

lines.text: When I was young, we would go fishing every weekend.
lines.intonation: 平穩、would 稍強調、句尾下收
